## Classes

### <a name="ovlens"></a>`ovlens`

ovlens runs openvox-strings over every module in an OpenVox environment and
serves the result to AI assistants through a read-only MCP server. On an
OpenVox server this class installs the gem into the agent's Ruby, regenerates
the documentation from a systemd timer, and can add an account that is only
able to reach the MCP server over SSH.

#### Examples

##### Document every environment

```puppet
include ovlens
```

##### Install from a gem file and document two environments

```puppet
class { 'ovlens':
  package_source => '/opt/ovlens/ovlens-0.1.0.gem',
  environments   => ['production', 'staging'],
}
```

##### Let one SSH key reach the MCP server

```puppet
class { 'ovlens':
  mcp_manage   => true,
  mcp_ssh_keys => {
    'alice' => { 'type' => 'ssh-ed25519', 'key' => 'AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAA...' },
  },
}
```

##### <a name="-ovlens--package_manage"></a>`package_manage`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install ovlens.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-ovlens--package_name"></a>`package_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

The gem to install.

Default value: `'ovlens'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--package_ensure"></a>`package_ensure`

Data type: `String[1]`

`installed`, `latest`, `absent` or a version.

Default value: `'installed'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--package_provider"></a>`package_provider`

Data type: `String[1]`

The package provider. `puppet_gem` installs into the agent's Ruby, which
already has OpenVox.

Default value: `'puppet_gem'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--package_source"></a>`package_source`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

A gem file or gem server to install from, for a gem that is not on
RubyGems.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovlens--command"></a>`command`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

The installed `ovlens` command.

Default value: `'/opt/puppetlabs/puppet/bin/ovlens'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--docs_dir"></a>`docs_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Where the documentation is written and read.

Default value: `'/opt/puppetlabs/server/data/ovlens'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--generate_ensure"></a>`generate_ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

`present` regenerates the documentation from a timer. Use `absent` when
something else runs `ovlens generate`, such as an r10k `postrun` command.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--generate_interval"></a>`generate_interval`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A\d+(s|sec|m|min|h|hr|d)\z/]`

How long after one run the next starts, as a systemd time span. A run with
nothing to do is cheap, because unchanged modules are not parsed again.

Default value: `'5min'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--environments"></a>`environments`

Data type: `Array[Pattern[/\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/]]`

The environments to document. Empty means all of them.

Default value: `[]`

##### <a name="-ovlens--environmentpath"></a>`environmentpath`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::Absolutepath]`

The directory holding the environments. Defaults to the server's
`environmentpath` setting.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-ovlens--mcp_manage"></a>`mcp_manage`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage an account that can only run the MCP server over SSH.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-ovlens--mcp_user"></a>`mcp_user`

Data type: `String[1]`

The name of that account.

Default value: `'ovlens'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--mcp_home"></a>`mcp_home`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Its home directory.

Default value: `'/var/lib/ovlens'`

##### <a name="-ovlens--mcp_ssh_keys"></a>`mcp_ssh_keys`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Struct[{ type => String[1], key => String[1] }]]`

The public keys allowed to log in as it, by a name of your choosing. Each
key is locked to the MCP server command. Keys not listed here are removed.

Default value: `{}`
